NEW PROGRESSIVE PARTY
A freer, fairer Caprica. Together.
Conversation guide | 2072

OUR PURPOSE
A centre-left liberal programme after four years in opposition: freedom to be yourself and a fair chance to thrive. These are proposals for the next term.

PUBLIC CARE
Good care, close to home. Whoever you are.
- Recruit and retain care teams, expand local clinics and publish waiting-time data so investment follows need.
- Bring mental healthcare into primary care and guarantee access to essential medicines.
- Pool the cost of parental and long-term illness leave through social insurance, supporting families and small employers alike.

AFFORDABLE HOMES
Secure renting. More homes. Room to put down roots.
- Allow more homes near jobs and public transport, with clear planning rules and strong safety standards.
- Expand public and cooperative housing, funded through transparent investment and a fairer tax on land value.
- Enforce decent standards and fair tenancy procedures. Put empty homes to use and introduce a progressive levy from the third residential property onward.

FAIR WORK
Rights at work. Freedom to organise. A stake in change.
- Protect collective bargaining and elected worker representation, with secret ballots and the freedom to join or leave a union.
- Offer paid retraining and benefits that follow workers between jobs. Help people share in new technology’s gains.
- Tackle wage theft and unsafe work. Give small firms practical compliance support and proportionate penalties for honest paperwork errors.

LEARNING & DISCOVERY
Opportunity should be, too.
- Strengthen public early-years provision and schools, with better teacher pay, training and retention.
- Protect publicly funded access to university and technical education. Make retraining possible throughout working life.
- Back independent research, regional laboratories and accessible R&D support for small firms. Require human accountability when AI affects people’s rights.

AN OPEN SOCIETY
Government should answer to you.
- Replace sweeping intelligence powers with targeted, judge-authorised surveillance. Ban torture, scrutinise budgets in Parliament and require independent reviews of secrecy.
- Defend expression, peaceful assembly, privacy and equal treatment. Keep the press and courts independent of government.
- Require public asset declarations, transparent appointments and a citizens’ constitutional convention on accountable parliamentary government.

CLIMATE & CLEAN ENERGY
Clean power. Warmer homes. Good jobs.
- Invest in renewables, nuclear energy, storage and the grid. Give communities a share in new clean-energy projects.
- Insulate homes and prioritise households facing high energy costs. Fund practical retraining where industries change.
- Set a firm emissions cap and create a green investment bank with published lending criteria, independent audits and clear public returns.

CONNECTED COMMUNITIES
Reliable journeys. More time for life.
- Strengthen public transport, with reliable local services, coordinated timetables and simpler fares.
- Build rail links in costed stages towards a network between state capitals. Improve rural bus and rail connections.
- Create safer walking and cycling routes, accessible stations and useful links to homes, schools and clinics.

CAPRICA & THE WORLD
A confident Caprica in the Columbian Union.
- Keep Caprica in the Columbian Union and pursue democratic, federalist reform through cooperation. Put negotiations under parliamentary scrutiny.
- Expand research, education and clean-energy cooperation. Support open trade with enforceable labour and environmental standards.
- Maintain a professional defence force under civilian control. Put diplomacy, international law and human rights at the centre of foreign policy.

START BY LISTENING
Ask what matters in your community. Discuss the proposals honestly, without presenting them as achievements or making unsupported claims.
